lines.zh: 我扇着翅膀，贴着草丛飞。
lines.en: I fly low along the grass, wings churning.

lines.zh: 我绕着那棵树转了一圈。
lines.en: I circle that tree once.
I head for that clump of flowers.
I bank sharply around a turn.
I climb another notch.
I keep going forward without pause.
I skim along the wall.

lines.zh: 我在半空悬了一下，又往前。
lines.en: I hover once, then push on.
I swing around a web.
I ride the wind a stretch.
I dart toward the noise.
I flick sideways and turn.
I settle on a leaf to rest.
I take off and keep patrolling.
I pass between two grass stems.
I drop a little.
I stop my wings and hang there.
I tuck my stinger under my body.
I hold my hover.
I turn half about slowly.
I watch below.
My wings still quiver faintly.
I am waiting for someone to walk by.
The wind sways me once.
I draw my legs in.
I rest on the leaf a while.
I float up a little more.
I hover and do nothing.
I turn square to you.
I hover beside your face.
I fix on your fingers.
You wave and I rise.
I fly half a circle around you.

lines.zh: 你一动，我的尾就压下来。
lines.en: When you move, my tail drops.
I hold in the air before your shoulder.
I do not like your smell.
I wait for you to move first.
I come a little closer.

lines.zh: 一记拍下来，我直往下掉。
lines.en: One swat and I drop.
I beat my wings hard to stop.
A corner is gone from my wing.
I fly off at a slant.
I duck under a leaf.
I slowly get my strength back.
My wings can still beat.

lines.zh: 我转了个圈，重新找方向。
lines.en: I circle once to find my line.
I keep that at the root of my wing.
I rise again.
I let none of that in.

lines.zh: 你把东西举起来，我绕着看。
lines.en: You hold it up and I circle it.
I do not come close for food.
I hover over it without touching.
That is far short of enough.
I fly off again.
That will not draw me.
I fly around your hand.
I rise a stretch.
I go on with my patrol.
I roll once before stopping.
I steady with my wings.
I bounce off your hand.
That impact does not trouble me.
I fly back where I was.
My wings are knocked askew.
I beat them back into line.
You carry real force.
I withdraw into the air.
Do not hit my wings.
That is not what I am looking for.
I fly two circles around it.
We rise and dip together in the air.
It flies to the tree and I follow.
We go one behind the other.
I settle on the branch beside it.
It leaves and so do I.
We make no sound.
We circle one flower.
I drift slowly away.
I settle on the flower and sip.
I hold it with my forelegs.
This one has been drained.
I taste it; very faint.
My feet are sticky with nectar.
I brush and carry the pollen off.
I fly to another.
This one is too small.
I take nothing.
I nudge it off to the side.
Something has broken into my ground.
I turn that way at once.
I nail it in my eye.
I raise my stinger.
I drop my height a notch.
It has not perceived me.
I come in from behind.
My stinger is already up.
It is still moving.
I count its steps.
I follow above it.
It banks and I bank.
I hang above and behind it.
I wait for it to settle.
When it looks up, I rise.
My wings are barely audible.
It is very close now.
I sink my body lower.
One more moment will do.
My tail is lined up.

lines.zh: 我俯冲下去，尾刺扎进去。
lines.en: I dive and drive my stinger in.
I stab once more.
I swing behind and sting.
That one missed.
It swats and I bounce away.
I land another sting.
I climb to find an angle.
It is flailing now.
I hover over its head.
Sting in, then pull straight up.
I fly up out of the grass.

lines.zh: 我一出现，周围的虫都散了。
lines.en: The moment I appear, the insects scatter.
I make one loop first.
There are plenty of flowers here.
I settle on a leaf tip.
I settle my stinger straight.
The wind pushes me off my line.
I fly toward that tree.
I begin patrolling this ground.
My shadow sweeps the ground.
Fire catches my wings and I fly wild.
I hit the ground and roll half over.
Water wraps my wings and they will not open.

lines.zh: 气浪一卷，我飞出去老远。
lines.en: The blast rolls me far away.

lines.zh: 箭杆从我的翅根穿过去。
lines.en: The arrow shaft came out through my wing root.
Cold settles on me and my wings stiffen.

lines.zh: 太久没吸到东西，我没劲了。
lines.en: Too long unfed and I have no strength.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我被震得直掉。
lines.en: Lightning flashes and I drop.
The wind takes me and I drop.
